_comment: Produced by Agent 1 (CCG). Every downstream agent reads this and rejects out-of-scope items.

package._note: v2.11 (C43): the ONE version and issue date of the delivery - every artifact file name, cover, Version Control row and cross-reference carries it.

oracle._note: v2.11 (Stage 9b, C37): the independent reference the research is regression-tested against - the authority's own calculation engine, or its published official worked examples where no engine exists. Stage 2 Check 7 fails without it.

option_mapper_scope._comment: For each option mapper, the codes that ARE in scope. Out-of-scope codes must be excluded from ALL artifacts.

integrations._note: Inbound files where HRB must parse/act = product_mapping_required=true. Never default inbound=not-in-scope.
